# src/manual/static/vendor/mermaid

The bundled Mermaid JavaScript distribution and its original MIT notice. The manual browser loads this renderer for fenced Mermaid diagrams; preserve vendor bytes and attribution when reviewing a dependency replacement.

[Parent folder](../README.md)
